# floating-ips

Floating IPs are public addresses that can be moved between instances.

## GET /v1/floating-ips

Operation `floating_ip_list`.

`GET /v1/floating-ips?tenant=&project=`. Flat FIP list. Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted, because `floating_ip/in_project/` is keyed by the FIP id.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_FloatingIp](schemas.md#resultspage_for_floatingip)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/floating-ips

Operation `floating_ip_create`.

`POST /v1/floating-ips?tenant=&project=`. Allocate a new floating IP from the fleet pool into the named project. Body matches the legacy `NewFloatingIp` shape; `silo=` is rejected on the customer surface.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewFloatingIp](schemas.md#newfloatingip)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [FloatingIp](schemas.md#floatingip)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/floating-ips/{floating_ip_id}

Operation `floating_ip_delete`.

`DELETE /v1/floating-ips/{floating_ip_id}`. The floating IP must be detached (attached_to == None) for the store to release it; 409 Conflict otherwise.

## POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/floating-ips/{floating_ip_id}/attach

Operation `project_floating_ip_attach`.

Atomically attach a FloatingIp to a NIC, replacing any existing attachment. The target NIC must live in the same tenant + project as the FloatingIp; mismatch surfaces as 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `floating_ip_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `project_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [AttachFloatingIpRequest](schemas.md#attachfloatingiprequest)

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [FloatingIp](schemas.md#floatingip)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/floating-ips/{floating_ip_id}/detach

Operation `project_floating_ip_detach`.

Detach a FloatingIp from its current NIC. Idempotent — a detach on an already-detached FloatingIp is a no-op that returns the current record.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |

| `floating_ip_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [FloatingIp](schemas.md#floatingip)
